cc: Google Pixel Buds help you translate easily with your Pixel or compatible Android phone. Use Live Translate mode to talk directly or Transcribe Mode to follow along with translations.
cc 2: To use with Google Translate, make sure you have:
cc 3: The Google Pixel Buds connected to your phone.
cc 4: (The device must meet all requirements within the linked article).
cc 5: A Google Assistant enabled Android device
cc 7: The latest version of the Google app
cc 9: The latest version of the Google Translate app
cc 11: Google Translate works with all Gemini-optimized headphones and Android phones. Gemini on Pixel Buds requires:
cc 12: A Gemini-enabled device with Android version 6.0 or higher.

cc 16: Get help from Google Assistant on Google Pixel Buds
cc 18: With the Google Translate app on your phone, your Google Pixel Buds can translate conversations between the following languages:
cc 19: To talk to someone with Live Translate mode:
cc 20: Say “Hey Google” to activate your voice assistant. Then say “Open the translate app.”
cc 25: Your default language is shown on the upper right, and the language to translate to is on the upper left. Tap the language to select a different language.
cc 27: This launches Google Translate in Live Translate mode in the languages that you select. The app listens for both languages and displays the translations on your phone.
cc 28: To have a specific message read back to you, tap the speaker icon in the top right corner of the translated message.
no-margin: Listen to another language with Transcribe mode
no-margin 2: In Transcribe Mode, your Pixel Buds continuously translate spoken language into your ear, and a transcript appears on your phone. You can translate from English to French, German, Italian, or Spanish.
no-margin 3: Use the transcribe feature in a quiet environment with one person speaking at a time for the best accuracy.
zippy-content: Step 1: Ask Google Assistant to help transcribe with Google Pixel Buds
zippy-content 2: While you're wearing Pixel Buds, press and hold either earbud or say, "Hey Google."
zippy-content 3: Request assistance, such as "Ayúdame a entender inglés."
zippy-content 4: This launches Google Translate in transcribe mode listening to the language you request (English) and translating to your default language (French, German, Italian or Spanish).
no-margin 5: French: Hey Google, aide-moi à comprendre l'anglais.
no-margin 6: German: Hey Google, hilf mir, Englisch zu verstehen.
no-margin 7: Italian: Hey Google, aiutami a capire l'inglese.
no-margin 8: Spanish: Hey Google, ayúdame a entender inglés.
zippy-content 6: Listen through your Pixel Buds along with the transcript on your phone. The text is read aloud after each sentence is translated.
zippy-content 10: At the bottom left corner, select the language you want to listen to (supported language: English).
zippy-content 11: At the bottom right corner, select the language with the spoken words to be translated into (supported languages: French, German, Italian or Spanish).
no-margin 11: Move closer to the audio source.
no-margin 12: Ask the speaker to talk louder, slower, or more clearly.
no-margin 13: Switch the microphone on and off.
no-margin 14: Check that your input or output languages are correct.
